description: Resident repair layer for DeepSeek Harness: splits glued tool-call JSON at proven boundaries, re-throws what it cannot prove, and names what it will not fix.
plugin_description: DeepSeek Harness patch set that intercepts MALFORMED_RESPONSE streams, splits fused tool-call arguments, re-throws unprovable buffers, and names the deterministic refusals it does not retry.
core_description: Pure repair and redaction engine for the dsh-remedy patch set. Nothing unproven is ever emitted; a failure it cannot split is re-thrown unchanged.
release_blurb:
### Release status

`0.4.9` is shipped and published as `latest` for both `dsh-remedy` and `dsh-remedy-core`, with `0.4.8` as the previous release and `0.4.7` before it.

P-0001, P-0002, P-0003 and P-0033 are verified on a real host: a fusion was repaired end to end, a synthesized call was dispatched, a budget refusal wrote a non-zero `refused` instead of pretending to repair, and a tool call with no identity was rewritten under a traceable id so the session stayed resumable. Every other patch is `tested`, and the repository registers 35 patches: 4 verified and 31 tested.

This release carries P-0034 and P-0035: a turn that failed with MALFORMED_RESPONSE is no longer booked as a quiet one, and a patch-layer row can no longer name a module nothing resolves.

Live evidence: [data/results/live-empty-call-2026-11-14T16-02-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-empty-call-2026-11-14T16-02-00.000Z.json), [data/results/live-2026-11-12T12-20-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-12T12-20-00.000Z.json), [data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T14-45-00.000Z.json) and [data/results/live-2026-11-10T16-30-00.000Z.json](data/results/live-2026-11-10T16-30-00.000Z.json).
